correctness.rationale: Orthogonal harmonic Bergman monomial basis indexed by Z gives T_(z^m) as a weighted bilateral shift. Degree-one products telescope except for -m<j<0, yielding gamma_(m,n)=n(m-n)/[(m+1)sqrt((n+1)(m-n+1))]. Images are distinct positive modes, so exact singular values, rank m-1 and square-zero follow. For any degree-d polynomial, linearity produces a reverse-triangular (d-1)x(d-1) crossing block with anti-diagonal proportional to a_d != 0, proving rank d-1 and nilpotence. Strict monotonicity in n(m-n) yields sharp norm; Riemann sum of sqrt(t(1-t)) gives beta-law and all moments including pi/8,1/6. Compared older weighted theorem with alpha=0 at degrees 2,3,8,31: all singular formulas equal within rounding. Inspected frozen verify.py; tests not a proof.
